title: THE ENDGAME OF LUCID MOTORS’ PSYCHOLOGICAL GAME
description: Addressed to Lucid Motors management, deceived investors, and the engineers who have been working unnecessary overtime for months:Lucid Motors executives claimed in the media that our intrusion was superficial and that only the systems of a “secondary supplier” had been compromised. They lied to you in an attempt to protect the company’s stock value. Today, with hard and incontrovertible evidence, we are putting the truth on the table.The package released today, totaling 159 GB, is not a simple file or an email list; it is the heart of the internal design architecture of your upcoming Midsize Vehicle Platform.
